An '''Aqualish''' was a shopkeeper of [[The Corner Shop]] during the [[Republic Era]]. The shop contained a secret casino, which led by a [[Duros]] kingpin. The [[Aqualish]] was [[Death|killed]] when [[Lazlo]] and [[Cad Bane's gang|his gang]] [[Raid on The Corner Shop|attacked]] the casino.<ref name="TheGoodLife" />
